description.narrative: N. of BSOs and SMES reached by joint activities with banking and nonbanking donors

comment.narrative: The outreach of 203 Business Support Organizations BSOs and Small and Mediumsized Enterprises SMEs underscores the projects commitment to fostering collaboration and engagement with key stakeholders in the financial sector. The BSOs and SMEs reached through joint activities represent a diverse spectrum of stakeholders across 16 countries with a total of 266 participants including 81 women. While the majority of participating organizations hailed from Egypt concerted efforts were made to ensure representation from both Southern and Northern Mediterranean countries.The breakdown of participation reveals a balanced representation with 80 SMEs and 20 BSOs reflecting a strategic alignment with the projects objectives to support and empower small businesses and entrepreneurs across the Mediterranean region.

comment.narrative: These comprehensive research instruments serve as resources for the projects beneficiaries offering indepth insights into various sectors and themes relevant to the Mediterranean business landscape. The project has not only met but exceeded its target value for this indicator achieving 160.The 16 industry outlooks encompass diverse sectors ranging from Education Research Development Gender Inclusion and Women Empowerment to Vocational Education and Training Transport and Logistics and the Green Transition. Each outlook has been meticulously developed through a rigorous research and information centralization process ensuring accuracy and reliability in the insights provided.
